title: Hiyam.AI
author: FishTraditional845
selftext:
There’s a platform on Instagram called Hiyam.AI where you basically can choose your own storyline, like a dating sim, or a fighting verse etc but it’s powered by AI and it could be any character verse you dream of. 

I made my own Naruto-verse AI sim! I hope you love it. The storyline is well branched with depth and interesting character plot twists. I usually write books which a following of over 21k, so I thought why not try creating a game for a change. I hope you love this!

[Akatsuki : Rogue Hearts](https://hiyam.ai/G3XDR8?s=PB7ERQ)
